title: Thai-Style Mansaf Ribs
description: A unique fusion of Eastern and Thai flavors with the tender juiciness of ribs. This dish is sure to impress with its rich and complex tastes.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine Thai Red Curry Paste and Middle Eastern Spices.
In a separate bowl, whisk together pineapple juice, soy sauce, and brown sugar.
Remove the membrane from the ribs and coat with the curry paste mixture.
Place the ribs on a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil and brush with the pineapple-juice mixture.
Bake for 2 hours and 30 minutes, or until the meat starts to fall off the bone.
While the ribs are baking, heat the vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the crumbled Morbier Cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Mix in the Eastern-Style BBQ Sauce until well combined.
Once the ribs are done, brush the melted cheese mixture on top of the ribs.
Return to the oven for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown.
Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
